hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℤ) : let d := (∑ i, (x i : ℝ)) / n let R := fun t : ℝ ↦ (t + max d 0, t + max (-d) 0) let G := fun (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) ↦ ∑' j : ℕ, u ^ j / (j.factorial : ℝ) / ((j + k).factorial : ℝ) let S := fun t : ℝ ↦ ∑ i, (((x i).natAbs : ℝ) - (2 * t + |d|) + 2 * (t * (t + |d|)) * G ((x i).natAbs + 1) (t * (t + |d|)) / G (x i).natAbs (t * (t + |d|))) let P := fun t ↦ likelihood x (R t) let C := {t : ℝ | (0 < t ∧ S t = 0) ∨ (t = 0 ∧ 0 < P t)} (C.Finite ∧ ∀ q, (q ∈ domain ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain q) ↔ ∃ t ∈ C, q = R t ∧ IsMaxOn P C t) ∧ ((∃ c, ∀ i, x i = c) → ∃! p, p ∈ domain ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain p) ∧ ((∀ i, x i = 0) → ((0, 0) : ℝ × ℝ) ∈ domain ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain (0, 0) ∧ ∀ p ∈ domain, IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain p → p = (0, 0)) ∧ ((∃ k : ℕ, (∀ i, x i = (k : ℤ) ∨ x i = -(k : ℤ)) ∧ (∃ i, 0 < x i) ∧ (∃ i, x i < 0)) → ∃! p, p ∈ domain ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain p) ∧ (∀ z : Fin n → ℕ, let d₀ : ℝ := (∑ i, (z i : ℝ)) / n 0 < d₀ → ((∀ t ≥ 0, (∑ i, poissonMass t (z i) / ((n : ℝ) * poissonMass d₀ (z i))) ≤ 1) ∨ (∃ j : ℕ, ∀ i, z i = j ∨ z i = j + 1)) → ((x = fun i ↦ (z i : ℤ)) → (d₀, 0) ∈ domain ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain (d₀, 0) ∧ ∀ p ∈ domain, IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain p → p = (d₀, 0)) ∧ ((x = fun i ↦ -(z i : ℤ)) → (0, d₀) ∈ domain ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain (0, d₀) ∧ ∀ p ∈ domain, IsMaxOn (likelihood x) domain p → p = (0, d₀)))
